Name: Turn-Based Combat (BIG UPDATE)
Author: GoodSmarts
Description:
[center][b][color=#ffff00][size=6]NEW UPDATE: 18 UNIQUE VILLAGERS CAN BE RECRUITED TO FIGHT WITH YOU IN BATTLE![/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#000000]-[/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]🌐 [color=#00ff00]English, 简体中文, Português (Brasil), 日本語, Español (España), 한국어, Русский, ไทย[/color][/size][/center]
[center][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Battle enemies with up to 4 players![/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Recruit townsfolk in single-player![/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Or battle your friends...[/size][/b][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/BVPNThG.gif[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/i5HNq69.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffff00][size=6]--- Future Plans ---[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler][left]I plan to [color=#ffff00]overhaul Limit Breaks[/color], making them super fancy and adding new impactful ones.[/left]
[color=#000000]-[/color]
[left]I'll be adding heavy [color=#ffff00]special compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/color], including backgrounds for SVE locations, music, and specializing SVE's boss fights for turn-based combat with their own unique boss themes. Currently, battle GUI changes to the Crimson Badlands' color theme, there's a battle background for that area, and a unique battle theme for fights there.[/left]
[color=#000000]-[/color]
[left]In the future, I'll be adding [color=#ffff00]more battle themes [/color]for when you're battling in different areas. Currently there's a default theme, a Skull Cavern theme, and a Crimson Badlands theme (Stardew Valley Expanded required).[/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[size=3]When there's a decent batch of songs finished for the mod, [color=#ffff00]I plan to release the music on Bandcamp[/color] to download for free. Maybe streaming, but Bandcamp for sure.[/size][/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][b][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]- Original Soundtrack -[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6][url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLd8d9e7l9a28]YouTube Playlist[/url][/size][/b][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][img width=588]https://i.imgur.com/uYUc9qz.gif[/img][/b][/center]
[center][b][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Features ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds a turn-based combat system, which triggers whenever you make direct contact with an enemy. You can still use weapons out of combat and fight like vanilla, but instead of getting hit, you're taken to a battle screen. Spend energy to use abilities during turn-based. Some special abilities can increase enemy item drops and Combat XP gained, so even though you can kill enemies outside of turn-based combat, you may find it beneficial to do turn-based anyway.[/color][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][color=#d4d4d8]You can [/color][b][color=#00ffff]recruit townsfolk to your adventuring party[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] and have them follow you around and join you in battles. Every character has a unique ability set and there are lots of combinations. [b][u]More in the Followers section below.[/u][/b][/color][/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]I designed sound effects and made battle music for during the fights. Volumes are configurable with GMCM. You can place audio files in the custom_music folder and enable custom music in GMCM to [/color][color=#00ffff][b]add your own battle themes[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8] to the game. The readme[/color][color=#d4d4d8].txt contains the proper file format you need.[/color][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]As of the most recent update, below the inventory menu are the Turn-Based Combat menu buttons. If you don't like them there, you can move them to the Skills menu in GMCM or hide them altogether. The very top of the GMCM menu has copies of these buttons, but that sucks compared to having them in your inventory, so I don't know why you'd only use those lol.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]The [color=#00ffff][b]Bestiary[/b][/color] lets you view every monster you've encountered in turn-based combat and view their stats and how many of them you've defeated.[/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
In battle, you have some options:
[list=1]
[*]Attack[/*]
[*]Dodge[/*]
[*]Abilities (or Trinket)[/*]
[*]Item (or view equipped Rings)[/*]
[*]Limit[/*]
[*]Flee[/*]
[/list]Your initial equipped weapon for the battle is whatever you had selected in your hotbar when the battle began. If it wasn't a weapon, you will attack with your fists. To equip a new weapon, choose [color=#ffffff]"[/color][b][color=#00ffff]Item[/color][/b][color=#ffffff]"[/color] and select one. The enemy gets a turn after you equip or use an item. You can pin items to the top of your item menu and move them around.[/left]
[left][center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][b][size=4]Currently Usable Battle Items:[/size][/b][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler][left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Food/Elixirs [/size][/b][size=3]- Anything that restores health or energy can be used on you or your friends.[/size][/color][/left]
[left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]All Bomb Types[/size][/b] - Consumable. Damages all enemies on the field for a set amount of damage.
[b][size=4]Warp Totems, Return Scepter, Staircase[/size][/b] - Instantly teleport away from the battle. You don't gain any rewards.
[b][size=4]Fishing Rods[/size][/b] - Cast at an enemy for a 50% chance to snag an item from them.
[b][size=4]Squid Ink [/size][/b]- Consumable. Inks all enemies on the field, making them miss attacks for a few turns.
[b][size=4]Bone Flute[/size][/b] - Play a convincing melody for a chance to make enemies flee.
[b][size=4]Ancient Drum[/size][/b] - Drum some tunes to inspire your party, giving everyone a damage and crit-chance boost.
[b][size=4]Lucky Purple Shorts[/size][/b] - ???[/color][/left]
[left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Monster Musk[/size][/b] - Consumable. Spawns 3-5 more enemies in the battle, and doesn't use your turn.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Muscle Remedy[/size][/b] - It's regular effect, but also clears all negative status effects.[/color][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffffff][size=4]Mystery Boxes[/size][/color][/b][color=#ffffff] - Spins slots that grant a random effect if you win, positive or negative. Golden Mystery Boxes are never duds and never have negative effects.[/color][/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][color=#000000][img width=557]https://i.imgur.com/z1aahHE.gif[/img][/color][/center]
[center][color=#b6b6b6][size=2]Use mystery boxes in battle to spin slots for a random effect.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[b][color=#00ffff]Dodge[/color][/b] costs some energy but grants a chance to avoid enemy attacks for two turns.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
The [color=#00ffff][b]Abilities[/b][/color] button opens a menu where you can choose from 5 different abilities unique to whatever weapon-type you're holding (Sword, Club, Dagger, Slingshot). New abilities are unlocked based on your vanilla Combat skill at levels 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Abilities cost energy, and some abilities can add status effects to yourself or to enemies.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]If you have a [color=#00ffff][b]trinket[/b][/color] equipped, it will appear on the left side of your Abilities button. [i]Every[/i] trinket has a unique turn-based effect, and you can use yours once per battle.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
When you take damage, your [color=#00ffff][b]Limit[/b][/color] meter fills, à la Final Fantasy. Once it's full, you can use a Limit Break ability. You can hold onto it between battles.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][b][color=#00ffff]Most enemies have unique actions[/color][/b] they may use during their fight. There are some pretty unique effects for some of them and a good deal of flavor text, à la Dragon Quest. They can inflict status effects on you or themselves.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][img width=581]https://i.imgur.com/6KLg2oM.gif[/img][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]Don't like playing the game? There's an [color=#00ffff][b]Auto-Battler[/b] [/color]button at the bottom of the battle screen. Turn it on and your character will act on their own. The settings button beneath it lets you choose your Auto-Battler combat strategy and tweak a few rules for it.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]There's a very in-depth [color=#00ffff][b]stats menu[/b] [/color]accessible from either the battle screen or a new button on the bottom left of the vanilla Skills menu (can be disabled). In multiplayer, you can compare stats with other players in your game and share them in chat.
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
If GMCM is installed, there's also an options button on the bottom right of the battle menu. From there, you can change a LOT of things, tuning the mod to your taste. In multiplayer, the host controls gameplay-related settings. There are even some [color=#00ffff][b]cheats[/b][/color] at the very bottom.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]- [/color][/center]
[left]Sometimes you can get lucky, and a [color=#00ffff][b]golden enemy[/b][/color] will spawn in the battle. You'll miss a lot against them, and they'll probably run away, but you can gain some nice rewards and 10x combat XP for defeating them. [color=#666666](Yeah they're pretty much metal slimes.)[/color][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left]You can [b][color=#00ffff]change the color scheme[/color][/b] of the battle menu in GMCM by choose a theme preset. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] installed, you can create a custom theme by turning on "Custom Theme" and using the color pickers. It's completely optional.[/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][size=2]One little note: Enemies that are meant to be invulnerable (like Mummies or Armored Bugs) can be killed if you defeat them in turn-based combat.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]Related: If an enemy can't damage you in real-time vanilla combat (like a Mummy on the floor), they will not be able to attack you during turn-based.[/size][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][color=#000000][img width=596]https://i.imgur.com/7cYPQ4G.gif[/img][/color][/center]
[center][b][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Followers ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][b]There are currently [color=#00ffff]18 followers[/color] you can recruit to fight with you in a single-player session only (for now). [/b]All of the marriage candidates are available and then some. To recruit someone, you need at least 6 hearts with them, then you interact with them while holding any weapon and choose "Invite to Party". You can have up to two followers at a time.
[color=#000000]-[/color]
[b][size=4]Full list of followers and their classes:[/size][/b]
[spoiler][size=4][b]Fighters:[/b][/size]
[color=#ff0000][b]Abigail[/b] - Reckless fighter with her rusty sword
[b]Linus [/b]- Uses the power of nature against monsters
[b]Krobus [/b]- Wields the dark power of the shadow people
[b]Alex [/b]- Tackles and knocks down enemies athletically
[b]Shane [/b]- Calls in Charlie and always has Pepper Poppers on-hand
[b]Sebastian [/b]- The biker aura-farms storms into existence
[b]Wizard [/b]- Casts powerful spells to defend Pelican Town and beyond
[b]Dwarf [/b]- Demolitionist with a knack for explosives[/color]

[size=4][b]Defenders:[/b][/size]
[color=#ffff00][b]Leah [/b]- Sculpts protective pieces to keep enemies at bay
[b]Marlon (SVE required) [/b]- Dutiful knight-protector who soaks up damage[/color]

[size=4][b]Support:[/b][/size]
[color=#00ff00][b]Harvey [/b]- Best healer in the Valley
[b]Maru [/b]- Machinist who utilizes technology and intellect
[b]Emily [/b]- Her mystic abilities buff the party significantly
[b]Sam [/b]- Energetic dude keeping the party energized and enemies burnt out[/color]

[size=4][b]Control:[/b][/size]
[color=#00ffff][b]Penny [/b]- Inspiration for the party, and poisonous cooking for enemies
[b]Haley [/b]- Uses her camera and charms enemies into attacking each other
[b]Elliott [/b]- Rewrites reality to seal monsters' fates[/color]

[b][size=4]Special:[/size][/b]
[color=#ff00ff][b]Evelyn[/b] - ... (10 hearts)[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#000000]-[/color]
Each follower has a unique ability-set based around their character and their role to fill in combat. There are Fighters, Defenders, Support, and Control. Followers get 3 energy bars, and each ability costs either 1, 2, or 3 bars. They recover one energy bar any time they Attack or Guard. Guard makes a follower take half damage until their next turn and restores some HP and energy.
[color=#000000]-[/color]
If anyone goes down, followers' Flee button changes to Revive, where they can revive any downed party member and restore some of their HP. If a follower ends a battle downed, they will say goodbye and head home for the day. They'll be ready to fight again tomorrow. You can also use items from your inventory to heal or revive followers.
[color=#000000]-[/color]
[color=#00ffff][b]Followers level up[/b][/color] from combat, gaining more HP, attack power, and defense with every level. Certain abilities' damage is based on the most powerful weapon the player has in their inventory, for battle-pacing purposes, in an effort to make followers always feel useful. They've been balanced pretty well (in my opinion) but are most certainly going to be tweaked a lot.
[color=#000000]-[/color]
The[color=#00ffff] [b]party menu[/b][/color] lets you get a good look at your current party members, as well as check stats for anyone not currently following you. You can heal followers from here, talk to them like normal, or dismiss them.
[color=#000000] -[/color]
[color=#000000]-[/color]
[center][img width=588]https://i.imgur.com/GyE9ROA.gif[/img][/center]
[/left]
[left][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/left]
[center][b][size=6]--- Multiplayer ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][size=3]Multiplayer is supported with [b][color=#00ffff]up to 4 players to a battle[/color][/b]. All players must have the mod installed on the same mod version. If one player doesn't have it, the mod is disabled for everyone. Followers are not currently recruitable in multiplayer sessions. We'll see.[/size][/left]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[left][size=3]If players are in the same room/area, anybody triggering a battle will pull everybody into a group battle. If you have more than 4 players, the mod will randomly select 3 other players in the room to join. The battle will wait for everyone to close any menus before it starts.[/size]
[center][color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color][/center]
[size=3]Swing a melee weapon at another player to [b][color=#00ffff]start a 1-on-1 PvP battle[/color][/b] with them. Either player can surrender at any time. By default, all health, energy, items, etc. are restored after the battle. You can turn on "PvP consequences" to get the option to kill your friend and send them to the clinic.[/size]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][img width=376]https://i.imgur.com/732pj2x.gif[/img][/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[/left]
[center][b][size=6]--- Android Support ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][size=3]Mobile players can use the [color=#00ff00]same main file download[/color].
I've only tested it on a few battles in the early mines, but everything looked good and it should be fully working. Report any bugs.[/size]
[center][size=3][color=#000000]-[/color][/size][/center]
[size=3]Unique to Android, there's an "info-tap" button on the bottom right of the menu. While on, pressing a button once will show a tooltip on the bottom right of the screen, and tapping again will select the option. Turning off info-tap will make buttons work in one press.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left]As of right now, Android does not have followers. I am working on it. Apologies.


[center][size=3][img width=568]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53557/53557-1792274366-840634282.jpg[/img]
[color=#000000]-[/color][/size][/center]
[/left]
[center][b][size=6]--- Requirements ---[/size][/b][/center]
[center][left][size=4]The only real requirement is SMAPI.[/size][/left]
[color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color]
[left][size=4]While [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] isn't [i]technically[/i] required, it is [b]EXTREMELY[/b] recommended. You really should already have it.[/size][/left]
[color=#000000][size=3]-[/size][/color]
[left][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] is optional, only required to create custom color themes in GMCM. But, it also cleans up the options menu and lets you collapse categories.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is only required to add Marlon as a follower. But this mod does include some special content/support for SVE and will have lots more SVE-specific content in the future.[/size][/left]
[/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color][/center]
[center][b][size=6]--- Compatibility ---[/size][/b][/center]
[left][size=5][b][color=#00ff00]MULTIPLAYER IS SUPPORTED FOR ONLINE AND LAN![/color][/b][/size][/left]
[left][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]ALL PLAYERS NEED THE SAME VERSION OF THE MOD INSTALLED.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]SPLITSCREEN IS [u]NOT[/u] SUPPORTED.[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][b][size=5][color=#00ff00]COMPATIBLE WITH ANDROID![/color][/size][/b][/left]
[center][left][color=#ff0000][size=3]Incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45879]Combatplus[/url], for obvious turn-based reasons.[/size][/color][/left]
[left][i][color=#ffff00]May have a quirk or two if a mod adds levels for combat skill past level 10, but it should be fine.[/color][/i][/left]
[left][i][color=#000000]---[/color][/i][/left]
[left][b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Special compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].[/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][i][color=#000000][size=3]---[/size][/color][/i] [/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Mostly compatible with modded weapons.[/color] [i][color=#666666]([/color][color=#666666]Safe if they're marked sword, dagger, club, or slingshot in the files.)[/color][/i][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with modded enemies.[/color] [i][color=#666666](They won't have unique abilities unless part of a vanilla monster family.)[/color][/i][/left]
[left][i][color=#ffff00]Not made for modded bosses, you will probably steamroll them. Stardew Valley Expanded bosses are okay but will get special treatment in the future.[/color][/i][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23697]Mastery Extended[/url].[/color] [/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] outfits.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url].[/color][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00]Compatible with controller or keyboard inputs.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Safe and seamless to install or uninstall mid-playthrough. Mod is designed with this in mind.[/b][/size][/color][/left]
[/center]
[center][color=#000000]-[/color]
[b][size=6]--- AI Disclosure ---[/size][/b]
[left]Very sorry to disappoint, but [b][color=#ffff00]a lot of code was written with[/color][/b][b][color=#ffff00] Claude[/color][/b][color=#ffffff]. However, this is not a minimal-effort AI-slop mod one-shotted in an afternoon. Everything has been designed and tested rigorously by me. Every mechanic and feature to the smallest detail is my own human creativity. I feel a certain way about AI writing code, but I am [i]strongly[/i] against AI music, AI images, AI videos, the like. That being said:[/color][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][size=5]There are [color=#ffff00]NO AI ASSETS[/color] anywhere in this mod.[/size][/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[left]All backgrounds were hand-made by me in Tiled. Sprites are all Stardew Valley's own assets in an effort to make the mod feel as "Stardew" as a mod like this can get.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffff00][size=4]The music and sound effects are NOT MADE WITH AI.[/size][/color][/b] I made them all myself in FL Studio. I am a musician and a huge fan of JRPGs. My musical process is something I would never let AI even get close to touching. It's my entire life.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][b][color=#ffff00]The only AI input is code. [/color][/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Ultimately, if it's a dealbreaker for you, I understand. There are a lot of mods on Nexus that aren't properly labeled as AI, and I feel morally obligated to let people know. Just know that if you're willing to give it a shot, the experience is completely from a human's mind, not shit out by "chatgbt make me turn-based combat mod."[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Oh yeah and none of this Nexus page is AI either. I'm capable of writing paragraphs and making GIFs and screenshots.[/left]
[/center]

Downloads.Description:
PC and Android.

- Added 18 villagers as followers with unique abilities
- Added Bestiary
- Added fast forward
- Added menu bar below inventory, configurable
- Cleaned up GMCM options significantly
- Lots of tweaks and fixes

Full list in changelog.
